attempts.raw: {"risk": 2, "reason": "This reverts a bugfix that restricted drag-and-drop of widgets into Bag/Flow parts by content type, removing that validation and restoring cross-type dragging behavior in the admin editor UI, which is low risk to site functionality but reintroduces the original bug (invalid content type placement) for editors using nested content/widget drag-and-drop."}

reason: This reverts a bugfix that restricted drag-and-drop of widgets into Bag/Flow parts by content type, removing that validation and restoring cross-type dragging behavior in the admin editor UI, which is low risk to site functionality but reintroduces the original bug (invalid content type placement) for editors using nested content/widget drag-and-drop.
